title: Not for traveling.
text: Not for traveling.. These are for keeping office garments clean at home; they do *not* work well when traveling. Yes, they are light, but with that they have no sturdiness. One ripped easily when it stuck in my closet and I was trying to pull it from a metal hanger. I use these to store clothes long-term now.
